scope: In the bilingual VLM training chapter, retain a direct link to the PixMo overview, stop serving the unverified historical raster, and explain code-guided annotation with the later MolmoPoint-GUISyn figure.

review.sources: Deitke et al., arXiv:2409.17146v2, Figure 1, §3 and Appendix F; Clark et al., arXiv:2603.28069v1, Figure 3, §4.4 and §10.
review.worked_case: Follow the generated AutoCAD-like HTML through browser rendering and Playwright bounding-box extraction. For Measure, the box center supplies the target point while the text model supplies an intent. A correct box does not make an ambiguous instruction unique. The paper's count refers to MolmoPoint-GUISyn, not PixMo.
review.style: Preserve the PixMo dataset descriptions and figures outside this replacement. Explain the data flow and possible labeling error in the two locales; keep claims about the original dataset separate from the later example.
review.rights: The Molmo v2 paper declares an arXiv non-exclusive license; no independent grant was verified for its composite Figure 1. The old PDF crop remains pinned and locally archived. MolmoPoint v1 declares CC BY 4.0. Figure 3 is the complete original PNG and depicts a synthetic HTML interface, not an external AutoCAD screenshot.
review.validation: Astro built 2083 pages; zero broken internal links, fragments or files. Passed 312 built-output, 202 asset-registry and 27 preservation and parity tests. The Python chapter checker ran 16 code-block invocations and verified the ten chapter figures against the previous inventory and source records. Inspected the original and the rendered RU/EN figure at 1280, 375 and 320 px in Chrome; the 375 px viewer showed the right-hand labels at 4× with panning and attribution. No commit, push or deployment.

### PixMo: от устного описания до точек и документов

слева показано, откуда берётся разметка, а справа — что получает модель

changes.new: используются детекции объектов, а в PixMo-CapQA вопросы строятся по готовой подписи. Это разные источники правильного ответа: для кода и часов он задан генератором, а детекции и подписи могут передать в новый набор ошибки предыдущей модели или разметки. Геометрию интерфейса тоже можно извлечь из кода. На схеме **MolmoPoint-GUISyn**, более позднего набора, языковая модель пишет HTML, имитирующий окно AutoCAD. Браузер отрисовывает страницу. Скрипт Playwright берёт прямоугольники видимых элементов из отрисованной страницы. Найдите кнопку `Measure`: её координаты уже известны, а текстовый учитель формулирует, зачем на неё нажать, например чтобы измерить длину. В обучающем примере VLM получает изображение и инструкцию, а целевая точка — центр этого прямоугольника. ![[02 Areas/ML & DL/00 Учебник/Assets/Figures/curated/vlm-training-2026-11-13/molmopoint-guisyn-figure3.png|Слева языковая модель пишет HTML для имитации интерфейса AutoCAD. В центре браузер отрисовывает интерфейс, скрипт выделяет рамки элементов. Справа к Measure, Add Pick Points и Cancel привязаны инструкции.]] *Christopher Clark et al., [MolmoPoint, рис. 3](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28069v1#S4.F3), [§4.4 и приложение 10](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28069v1#S10), [оригинал PNG](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28069v1/MolmoPSyn_overview.png), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Рисунок без изменений.* Авторы сгенерировали 36 тысяч скриншотов и 2 млн точек, по пять инструкций на элемент. Координаты не приходится угадывать по пикселям. При этом рамка не проверяет смысл инструкции: если две кнопки позволяют измерить длину, правильный центр одной из них ещё не делает задание однозначным. Метки задачи помогают не смешивать требования к ответам.

changes.old:
Web captions name salient objects but omit detail. Dense captions cover background, attributes, and relations. OCR and document data require literal accuracy and layout. Grounding pairs language with points or boxes. Interleaved documents teach correspondence across several images and text spans.

Molmo’s PixMo collection connects separate human-collected datasets to dense captioning, question answering, pointing, and grounded counting.

![[02 Areas/ML & DL/00 Учебник/Assets/Figures/curated/vlm-2026/molmo-figure1-data-and-capabilities.png]]

*Figure 1 from Deitke et al., [Molmo and PixMo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.17146), PDF p. 2. Different data collections support different model capabilities.*

PixMo's dense descriptions were collected by asking people to speak about an image and transcribing that speech. Point annotations provide a different supervision channel: the output location can be checked, and grounded counting can be audited by inspecting the individual points. The annotation interface therefore shapes what the model learns, not only how quickly examples are collected.

Web captions name salient objects but omit detail. Dense captions cover background, attributes, and relations. OCR and document data require literal accuracy and layout. Grounding pairs language with points or boxes. Interleaved documents teach correspondence across several images and text spans.

[Figure 1 of Molmo and PixMo](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2409.17146v2#page=2)
shows how annotations are obtained on the left and the resulting tasks on
the right. A person supplies the coordinates in PixMo-Points; in
PixMo-Clocks, the time is set before the clock face is drawn.

PixMo's dense descriptions were collected by asking people to speak about an image and transcribing that speech. Point annotations provide a different supervision channel: the output location can be checked, and grounded counting can be audited by inspecting the individual points. The annotation interface therefore shapes what the model learns, not only how quickly examples are collected.

changes.old:
In PixMo-AskModelAnything, a person selected an image and asked a question. A language model received OCR and a detailed caption, proposed an answer, and the person accepted or corrected it against the image. The human saw pixels; the text assistant depended on the supplied evidence. PixMo-Points uses human point annotations. Counting examples list points before the count, allowing inspection of the counted objects, but valid coordinates alone do not prove that every object was found or that none was counted twice.

PixMo-Docs renders generated code into tables and diagrams; that code supplies values and structure for questions. PixMo-Clocks fixes the time when constructing a clock face. PixMo-Count relies on detections, and PixMo-CapQA on captions. The latter annotations inherit the detector's or caption's errors, unlike a generator-defined value. Task/style tags distinguish benchmark-specific short answers from open conversation; otherwise strict extraction format can become an unwanted default for all requests.

Synthetic data scales strict formats but inherits teacher errors. Provenance matters: a confident wrong OCR label from a proprietary teacher can be distilled into an open-weight student.

## Instruction and preference tuning
changes.new: In PixMo-AskModelAnything, a person selected an image and asked a question. A language model received OCR and a detailed caption, proposed an answer, and the person accepted or corrected it against the image. The human saw pixels; the text assistant depended on the supplied evidence. PixMo-Points uses human point annotations. Counting examples list points before the count, allowing inspection of the counted objects, but valid coordinates alone do not prove that every object was found or that none was counted twice. PixMo-Docs renders generated code into tables and diagrams; that code supplies values and structure for questions. PixMo-Clocks fixes the time when constructing a clock face. PixMo-Count relies on detections, and PixMo-CapQA on captions, so their annotations can inherit errors from the detector or the caption. Code can also supply the geometry of an interface. In the later **MolmoPoint-GUISyn** dataset, an LLM writes HTML to imitate an AutoCAD window. A browser renders it, and a Playwright script extracts bounding boxes for the visible elements. Follow the `Measure` button in the figure: its location is already known when the text model writes an instruction about what to do with it, such as measuring a length. In the training example the VLM receives the image and the instruction, and the center of that bounding box is the target point. ![[02 Areas/ML & DL/00 Учебник/Assets/Figures/curated/vlm-training-2026-11-13/molmopoint-guisyn-figure3.png|An LLM writes HTML for a simulated AutoCAD interface. The browser renders the interface and a script extracts bounding boxes. The Measure, Add Pick Points, and Cancel boxes are paired with natural-language intents.]] *Christopher Clark et al., [MolmoPoint, Figure 3](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28069v1#S4.F3), [§4.4 and Appendix 10](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28069v1#S10), [original PNG](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28069v1/MolmoPSyn_overview.png), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Unmodified figure.* The authors generated 36,000 screenshots and 2 million points, with five instructions per element. The script obtains locations without inferring them from pixels. It does not check what an instruction means: if two buttons can measure a length, a correct bounding-box center still leaves the task ambiguous. Task or style tags distinguish short benchmark answers from open conversation; without that distinction, a strict extraction format can become the default for all requests. A confident but wrong OCR label from a proprietary teacher can still be distilled into an open-weight student. ## Instruction and preference tuning
